values.note: Booking engine, 23-ft rig, 2 guests, cheapest full-hookup type (Resort Back-In): January 2027 $60, November 2026 $70, May 2027 $84, June 2027 Saturday $85.50. Other types in November: pond view $80, riverview $75, premium riverfront $78, riverfront $86. Before tax. Read 2026-10-31.

summary: Fees added $60-$86, over the gate but inside a gateway. Booking, 50A, pull-through, laundry, store, wifi added. Note cleaned. Stored pond vs the riverfront rows flagged.
flags: GATE: over $50 at every date read ($60 January to $85.50 June). Passes only by the gateway exemption: Cincinnati metro 32 km. Not a Good Sam Park (stored false). No standing minimum read.

GOOGLE: 4.2 from 492 reviews, phone (812) 438-4500 matches. All five read warm ('clean', 'themed weekend'; 'They rent golf carts and have a trail to the river bank'). One: 'We basically live here during the summer.' Seasonal share not stated; south block on imagery has dark-roofed rows that may be cabins or park models.

WATER (re-audit): stored pond is the main block only; its small central pond suits the 'Resort Pond View' type. A second section of long rows runs along the Ohio's bank near 38.9756,-84.8338, about 850 m ENE of the pin, east row ~35 m from the river behind a tree line. It fits the operator's 'Riverfront Back-In' and the old note, but I read no site map tying it to Unhitched by name, and a tree line screens the bank. Could be riverfront for those; main block is ~1 km from the river. Not changed.
WEBSITE: stored is the chain root; park page is https://www.unhitchedrv.com/rising-sun/. PIN 38.9727,-84.8440 on the main block, fine, but see the river section.
SEASON: stored year_round rests on note prose; engine sells January 2027, operator states no season. Left alone.
note: Private (fka Little Farm on the River / Beyonder), on the Ohio River; lower-section sites back directly to the river. Distinct from the nearby casino RV park. --Claude
